notes.title: Additional
notes.content:
03/25/23 update
Additional and changes
bug fixed: level 1 gem gave 2 gems, now it's fixed.

Gems and Emeralds +5 to max mana (Mana mana only)

As the button to activate the monument is the same as the tentacle, this has been harmful because
ends up spending 2 mana, so now as a reward when leaving the monument you get 3
of mana

You can now spend 10 coins to Reactivate the monument

box added
Added coins
Two new shots added (are unlocked through purchases using the currency)

notes.title: Vila versão 0.1
notes.content:
Update 12/07/22, I come here to bring the first update of "Eye"
village version 0.1
Village was added to the game
To go to your village press "select" or "back" to open the screen selection, go to the top left.
bonfire for lighting your village added+
the first houses in your village have been added+
squirrel to decorate your village has been added+
globin added, it gives 1 life and mana+ potion refill
Added health and mana selection by pressing "LB" and opening the powerups menu
